title: Proof Architecture in the OpenAI Lean Library: Representation, Locality, and Semantic Transport
review_type: Applied depth revision, targeted source reading, compilation/reuse experiment, citation/build checks and rendered-PDF review.
verdict: The specific depth gaps in the earlier audit have been addressed. The manuscript is stronger as a focused comparative review of formal interfaces; its novelty rests on synthesis and explanatory analysis.

ratings.reason: New proof-body explanations address each targeted gap, including both the graph lifting chain and Crouzeix input construction.
The added detail explains the mechanisms while retaining the existing six-case structure and elementary examples.
Size and numerical invariants, finite-dimensional bundling, image filters, analytic germs, coordinate injectivity and actual API reuse now have explicit explanations.
The projection budget and analytic collar are followed through their producers, with exact retained source locations.

ratings.category: Evidence for unusualness or formalization novelty
ratings.reason: Zar and SampCert give a closer specification comparison, but this remains a focused synthesis rather than a corpus-wide demonstration of unprecedented Lean methods.

changes.revision: Explained Safe, fold charges, PolySafe substitution and AttrSafe numerical invariants; distinguished binary width from the value of an exponent.
Traced the two-block Gram comparison, isometric slice reindexing, exact restriction normalization, gain factor and ordered/unordered budget conversion.
Explained the finite-dimensional construction of a continuous bilinear wedge and distinguished inherited exterior-derivative infrastructure from the project bridges.
Traced the finite Taylor remainder and Fourier orientation, local boundary-germ compatibility, analytic collar, injective neighborhood and inverse disk thickening.
Explained image-filter extension to arbitrary nets and added a compiled corollary composing the actual upstream ideal correspondence.
Explained a local atomic-coordinate producer and the six concrete obligations consumed by inherited-seam transport.
Added Zar with verified ACM metadata and compared its compilation/equidistribution specification and SampCert law semantics with the selected every-tape complexity specification.
Retained all six literal OAI import closures, added checked evidence spans and portable Mathlib preparation/reuse scripts, and tightened the method so the overview fits without a large gap.

upstream_reuse.scope: Three TraceCone modules plus one compositional corollary; other five cases and Comparator were not compiled by this experiment.

original_examples.scope: Original review examples; source-corpus endpoints were studied statically.

remaining_scope_limits: The depth review and ratings are internal judgments by the editing agent, not external peer review or acceptance probabilities.

Compilation covers three unmodified TraceCone modules and one importing corollary, plus five separate elementary examples. The other five selected OAI cases and Comparator were studied statically in this revision.
The 546 retained artifacts and 518-module closure count measure source availability. They do not assert that every retained proof body was analyzed in depth.
The composition corollary is elementary and demonstrates API reuse. It is not presented as a new mathematical theorem.
Predecessor comparisons support the specific architectural distinctions discussed; they do not establish that the techniques are unprecedented across formal mathematics.
public_release_action: None. Existing public v1.1.1 metadata retained; this is a separate local revision.
